headline: Small SSE at a prime angle — dawn glass, then it folds up.
today: Two-foot SSE lined up on the good angle, and the dawn cross-off into a light morning is your glassy window. Log or groveler, work the incoming tide early. Onshore takes over by afternoon and it's done.

daysToWatch.note: Onshore S 12-14mph from dawn on — junked out despite the prime angle. Not worth it.
Best shot of the week: 2-2.5ft and a light dawn WSW. Short-period so keep the log handy, but it should be clean early.
